axes.selection: one shared orthonormal basis E (1024 x 896), the top eigenvectors of the reader-pca second moment of the residual stream pooled over all 29 residual-write endpoints with each endpoint equalised to trace one; a per-boundary chart is not expressible in a stock child because the residual is a running sum with nowhere to put a chart transition.  The conv blocks' internal channels are a pivoted-Cholesky coreset of the parent's own, because Lfm2ShortConv gates channelwise and no rotation of that space is representable
axes.solve: readers folded EXACTLY as sqrt(1024/H) W diag(g) E diag(1/g_c) with g_c = diag(E^T diag(g) E) (the lift preserves the norm, so the parent's RMSNorm at the lifted row and the child's at the row differ by that one constant); writers folded as E^T W and re-solved against the child's own installed activations by the prior-anchored ridge under THE LAW; the final norm's diagonal solved in closed form against the tied head's Gram
